---
title: "External RDS report"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
params:
  artifact_dir: "artifacts"
  cpus: 1
  input_dir: "."
  input_filename: null
  meta:
    value: {}
---

```{r}
rds_path <- file.path(params$input_dir, params$input_filename)
if (!file.exists(rds_path)) {
  stop("Input RDS file does not exist: ", rds_path)
}

object <- readRDS(rds_path)
object_class <- paste(class(object), collapse = ", ")
object_dim <- dim(object)
assay_names <- character()
first_assay <- NULL

if (requireNamespace("SummarizedExperiment", quietly = TRUE) &&
    methods::is(object, "SummarizedExperiment")) {
  object_dim <- c(SummarizedExperiment::nrow(object), SummarizedExperiment::ncol(object))
  assay_names <- SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(object)
  if (length(assay_names) > 0) {
    first_assay <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(object, assay_names[[1]])
  }
}

summary_rows <- data.frame(
  field = c("input_file", "class", "rows", "columns"),
  value = c(
    basename(rds_path),
    object_class,
    if (length(object_dim) >= 1) object_dim[[1]] else NA_integer_,
    if (length(object_dim) >= 2) object_dim[[2]] else NA_integer_
  )
)

if (methods::is(object, "SummarizedExperiment")) {
  summary_rows <- rbind(
    summary_rows,
    data.frame(
      field = c("assays", "row_data_columns", "column_data_columns"),
      value = c(
        paste(assay_names, collapse = ", "),
        ncol(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(object)),
        ncol(SummarizedExperiment::colData(object))
      )
    )
  )
}

summary_rows <- summary_rows[!is.na(summary_rows$value) & nzchar(summary_rows$value), ]

dir.create(params$artifact_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.table(
  summary_rows,
  file = file.path(params$artifact_dir, "external_rds_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(summary_rows, caption = "RDS object summary")
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(first_assay)) {
  library_size <- Matrix::colSums(first_assay)
  detected_features <- Matrix::colSums(first_assay > 0)

  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
  hist(
    library_size,
    breaks = 20,
    col = "#6BAED6",
    border = "white",
    main = "Library size per cell",
    xlab = "Total counts"
  )
  hist(
    detected_features,
    breaks = 20,
    col = "#74C476",
    border = "white",
    main = "Detected features per cell",
    xlab = "Features with non-zero counts"
  )
}
```
